scope: Original-control public FreeType call nesting, bounded glyph-slot observations, explicit resource cmap checks and existing-model repertoire inventory. No source/PDF font-outline, hinting, geometry or raster fidelity pass; issue remains open.

repertoire.scope: All 18 font-option cases in the frozen 1403-input runtime cohort; 13 measured native originals, not evidence that all 18 require fonts. Model roles, not source-resource identity.

retained_attempts.result: Refused first render: unrecorded FreeType nesting interleaves internal cmap probes. All 24 exploratory traces retained; no authoritative mappings from that observer.

retained_attempts.result: Refused because the non-rendering 75785 load is itself nested. Final analyzer pairs only outer cmap and outer render, retaining and counting nested records. No captures retried for this analysis correction.

limitations: The 336 observed slots are only the authored unique-code controls at C8 mode 2, style 10a5, font word 6 and the explicitly stated 801d/80ce states. No formula or other style/variant mapping is inferred.
Repeated glyph caching, real-document read order, symbols, other scripts, ornaments and HN-B mode 0 remain unmeasured by this trace protocol.

Resource cmap queries match pinned files, but family names and matching slots do not prove the actual opened viewer path or equality of two outlines. No vendor glyph outline/program was exported or embedded.

The existing model supplies expected native roles and semantic repertoire; these are not independently observed font identities for the 13 originals. Five other font-option cases are outside that model and are not counted as native-font passes.
The 24 stable page captures only establish two equal cached observations each, not viewer readiness or source/PDF raster parity.
No converter, API, supported format, catalog status, output PDF, dependency or release change. Rust #475 stays research-only.
